SurveyResponse.title: SurveyResponse
SurveyResponse.description: User responses from the Curbside Compass public parking trade-off survey and feedback form

personaId.description: Identifier of the resulting persona (e.g., q1_transit_champion, q2_pragmatic_resident)

personaTitle.description: Display title of the user's calculated persona

quadrant.description: Compass quadrant: Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q4

totalX.description: Cumulative fiscal axis score (-2: Taxpayer ... +2: User)

totalY.description: Cumulative regulatory axis score (-2: Open ... +2: Regulated)

answers.description: Map of survey question IDs to chosen option IDs

simConfig.description: Final parking simulation configuration resulting from choices

rating.description: User 1-5 rating of Edmonton parking program trade-off outcomes

feedback.description: Optional open-ended user commentary or rationale

postalCode.description: Edmonton postal code FSA or entered code for spatial analysis
